name: ShitSlam2
detailed_description:
ShitSlam2 is a multiplayer chaotic sandbox shooter, where you can hang out with your friends, make funny skits, or have battles with them. There are many VERY ORIGINAL game modes that will twist the game rules, such as warfare, where you can engage in an ongoing war or just sit back and watch chaos unfold with our TOTALLY SMART AI and AI Air support. 



Some key features: 

  • variety of different game modes:

    • Sandbox: There are no rules, play to your heart's content <3

    • Warfare: engage in an epic battle or just lie back and watch chaos unfold

    • Knock: Take a baseball bat and knock your annoying ass friend off an island

  • Physical environment :3

  • VERY ORIGINAL WEAPONS 

  • Multiplayer 

  • Multiple different player skins/outfits

  • Fish world - Lead developer: I was into games at a very young age, like a . . regular . . . child, and growing up, I loved to watch indie devs such as Dani dev and Fancy dev, so I decided to start getting into it myself—what could go wrong? (this game) I've been learning for two years, and I'm ready to take on a bigger and better project! We are still learning, so please excuse the lack-luster ass features :3

  • Totallyahuman15 - Musician: Fish world locked me in his basement and is forcing me to play test and make music. He has my family. PLEASE SEND HELP 

  • beansarebeans4 - Cool map maker: I'm not getting paid for tis but it ok

  • Ajkcdk - Modeler: I beat my shit every time I was in the staff call

  • Stayz - Developer & Playtester: I’m Stayz, the Owner of StayzGamezStudio. It used to be just me, learning how to code with trial and error in Scratch. After a few years, I wanted to try Unity because of indie game devs like Dani and others. I made and released a Game, but not on Steam. Not Yet Anyways. I have recently learned Unreal Engine, so now I can help my friend, Fish World. I am Glad I get to help code ShitSlam2 and more games with Fish World Entertainment in the Future. I hope you enjoy the Games we make.

  • PizzaGamer - Playtester: I haven't done shit

  • SnakeEye - Playtester: Uhhh yeah pretty cool.
